mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) over 3 months signals improved corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in demand expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE of >0.3 percentage points in the last month signals rising labor costs expectations, leading to risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase > 0.3pp in the last month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE rises >0.3pp in the last month, or the increase is not followed by negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous quarterly rise in GDPC1 (demand) and monthly decline in INDPRO (supply) signals demand-supply imbalance, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >5% and INDPRO falls >2% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) over 60 days when the specified interaction occurs, or the interaction does not precede negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals higher interest rate expectations, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) over 20 days when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% in a tightening regime, or the regime is not tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary) and decline in UNRATE (labor) signals conflicting policy and labor market signals, leading to risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% and UNRATE falls >0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) over 20 days when the specified interaction occurs, or the interaction does not precede negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply) over three months indicates robust production growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05) over 60 days when INDPRO shows sustained growth, or the growth is not followed by positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly GDPC1 value exceeding 19087.57 (as of t-4mo) signals stronger than expected demand, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05) over 5 days when GDPC1 exceeds 19087.57, or the increase is not followed by positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent monthly decline in UNRATE (labor) and rise in INDPRO (supply) signals improving labor market conditions and robust production, fostering market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls >0.2% and INDPRO rises >1% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05) over 20 days when the specified interaction occurs, or the interaction does not precede positive returns.
